facts.text: TriFingerRotateCubeLevel0-v1 is registered with max_episode_steps=250
The task's default robot is "trifingerpro"
TriFingerPro's active joint list names the nine finger joints: base-to-upper, upper-to-middle and middle-to-lower for each of the 0, 120 and 240 degree fingers
The controller configs list pd_joint_delta_pos first
A control_mode of None selects the first supported control mode
The pd_joint_delta_pos controller bounds each joint delta to -0.1 to 0.1 and applies it as a delta
PDJointPosControllerConfig normalises the action space by default
A normalised action space is Box(-1, 1) with the shape of the controller's joint action space
The environment's action space is the agent controller's action space and the single action space is its unbatched form
The task's size parameter is 0.065 m and its goal_radius is 0.02 m
Success requires the object-to-goal position distance below 0.02 m and the quaternion difference below 0.1 rad
The dense reward is clamped to -15 to 15 and set to 15 on success
The normalised dense reward is dense/(2*15)+0.5, so it lies in 0 to 1
The supported reward modes are normalized_dense, dense, sparse and none, in that order
A reward_mode of None selects the first supported reward mode
The simulation runs at sim_freq 100 Hz and control_freq 20 Hz; every control step contains sim_freq/control_freq simulation steps
The control timestep is 1/control_freq and the simulation timestep is 1/sim_freq
The supported observation modes start with state
An obs_mode of None selects the first supported observation mode
A state observation is the agent's proprioception plus the task's extra observations
The default proprioception is the robot's qpos and qvel, plus a controller state when it is non-empty
The RotateCube task adds goal_pos, goal_q, obj_p and obj_q to the extra observation
A state observation is flattened with flatten_state_dict before it is returned

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial joints and the goal sample and the fake's dynamics are deterministic, so this package repeats a trajectory for one seed; upstream draws from torch/numpy generators, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators or constraints: the fake moves the nine finger joints and the cube by a direct kinematic update (F0)

the fake observation is a flat 32-value vector laid out like the default state observation (9 qpos, 9 qvel, 3 goal_pos, 4 goal_q, 3 obj_p, 4 obj_q), but every value comes from the kinematic stand-in, not from SAPIEN/PhysX
the fake samples initial joints and the goal with Python's random.Random while upstream uses torch/numpy generators, so one seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory
rendering, cameras, sensor data and visual observation modes are not modelled; the fake serves the default state observation only
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance simulated time by the 50 ms control step only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last world state stays readable
